description: Restore a snapshot as a table in the app: under its original name if that table no longer exists, otherwise as <table>_restored_<timestamp>, or as asTable. Rows only: re-create constraints, indexes and defaults with apply_schema_change. Returns { table }.

app.description: The app's slug or id (from list_apps / create_app).

asTable.description: Name for the restored table (must not exist).

name: restore_snapshot
